--- title: "SER: gIBSS vs CAVI-cf on shared simulations" subtitle: "Part A figures restricted to the datasets fit by BOTH methods (CAVI-cf runs 10 reps/cell vs gIBSS 50, on the same cells), so the comparison is on identical data." engine: jupyter jupyter: python3 execute: fig-dpi: 110 --- ::: {#status .cell execution_count=2} gIBSS vs CAVI-cf, single-effect SER, **360 shared datasets** (36 cells x 10 reps). Every figure below is on identical data. ::: ## 1. PIP calibration {#sec-pip-cal} ::: {#cell-fig-pip-cal .cell .column-page execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} R.pip_calibration(pip, facet=["design"], filt=SER, methods=METHODS) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![PIP calibration, shared datasets. gIBSS and CAVI-cf coincide.](ser_shared_sims_files/figure-html/fig-pip-cal-output-1.png){#fig-pip-cal width=415 height=614} ::: ::: ## 2. FDP vs power {#sec-fdp-power} ::: {#cell-fig-fdp-power .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} R.power_fdp(pip, facet=["design"], filt=SER, methods=METHODS, panel=(3.2, 3.0)) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![FDP vs power as the PIP threshold is swept, shared datasets.](ser_shared_sims_files/figure-html/fig-fdp-power-output-1.png){#fig-fdp-power width=1145 height=319} ::: ::: ## 3. Enrichment detection by logBFSER {#sec-logbf-roc} ::: {#cell-fig-detect-roc .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} R.logbf_roc(cs, facet=["design"], filt=SER, methods=METHODS, label_kind="detect", panel=(3.4, 3.4)) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![Enrichment-detection ROC (enriched vs matched null, ordered by logBFSER), shared datasets.](ser_shared_sims_files/figure-html/fig-detect-roc-output-1.png){#fig-detect-roc width=1111 height=363} ::: ::: ## 5.
